The order path runs from `postOrder` in the chart, through a POST to `/order`, into the webservices.rest resource, then `OrderServiceImpl`, then Hibernate. Every link was read in source except the public `saveOrder` body (lines 115–118), where I confirmed only the declaration.

**Frontend → server → database**

1. **Frontend sender:** `postOrder` in `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/postOrders.ts` (lines 202–209). It does `openmrsFetch(\`${restBaseUrl}/order\`, { method: 'POST', body })`.
2. **Frontend caller:** `postOrders` in the same file (lines 157–200). It walks the order basket for the patient, prepares each item, and calls `postOrder` for each one.
3. **Server REST handler:** `OrderResource1_10.save` in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_10/OrderResource1_10.java` (lines 326–329). It calls `Context.getOrderService().saveOrder(delegate, null)`. `OrderResource2_2` (the version served by default) inherits this method.
4. **Base REST handler:** `OrderResource1_8.save` in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_8/OrderResource1_8.java` (lines 72–75). It has the same body, and `OrderResource1_10` overrides it.
5. **Core service:** `OrderServiceImpl.saveOrder(Order, OrderContext)` in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/OrderServiceImpl.java` (line 115, public). It delegates to the private `saveOrder(order, ctx, isRetrospective)` (lines 165–224), which runs the validation and the discontinue/revise handling. It then calls `saveOrderInternal` (lines 350–379), which assigns the order number and auto-expire date and calls `dao.saveOrder(order)`.
6. **Data access:** `HibernateOrderDAO.saveOrder` in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateOrderDAO.java` (lines 92–95). It calls `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate(sessionFactory.getCurrentSession(), order)`, which writes to the database.

The interface declarations are `OrderDAO.saveOrder` (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/OrderDAO.java`, line 47) and `OrderService.saveOrder` (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/OrderService.java`, line 135).
